text: Akanyonyi kayingidde mu kibiina nga tusoma.
Amakubo gaffe gaseerera nnyo mu budde bw'enkuba ebirime ne bituvundako.
Osaanidde owe buli muntu ekitiibwa okusinziira mu kiti mw'abeera ajjidde.
Enkyukakyuka mu kukola oluguudo luno ereese akalipagano kangi.
Kikwewuunyisa ng'abantu be baawa obutimba bw'ensiri ate babulundiramu nkoko.
Yawaayiriza munne nti mubbi kyokka naye ne bamusiba.
Abasawo bonna abajjanjabira mu nkola ey'ekizungu bavumirira enzijanjaba y'ekinnansi.
Waliwo obutakwatagana mu kusalawo ku disitulikiti.
